name: Atlantic Technological University
summary: Technological university on campuses from Galway and Mayo to Sligo and Donegal: about 140 honours degrees via CAO, most needing only basic Maths.

ib.text: Six subjects with English (or Irish) and usually Maths; no third language. Strictest: Sligo Engineering HL Maths 5. ATU asks non-native speakers for IELTS 6.5 'or equivalent'; CAO accepts IB English A SL 4.

notes: Where one exam system dominates a course's applicants, ATU may share its places out by system and rank IB applicants among themselves.
Art, Fine Art and Animation ask for a portfolio as well as points.
The same subject is often taught on more than one campus under different CAO codes, so check the campus before you list a code.
